Several of these are corroborated by the compiled script: playPortalCreatedSound,
playPortalLaunchSound, playPortalKilledSound, playPortalFailedSound all exist as
identifiers, which is why the four portal cues are confident rather than assumed.
Audio is converter output and gitignored. A fresh clone has none, every cue no-ops,
and the game runs silently. Missing audio must never be fatal.
